name: s3-standard-faults-wal
note: s3-standard-faults (kept unchanged as the baseline — see that profile) plus ambiguous faults on the shared WAL log (class nodewal: data, seal, floor, index). Three cases: ambiguous = the PUT landed, then an error is returned (case a); retried = the PUT landed and the answer is that of object_store's own retry — Create sees AlreadyExists on cairn's very first attempt (case b); late = the PUT lands 2 500 ms late, after the attempt was cancelled by the 2 s put_timeout, and is still applied (case c). On code from before ambiguous shared-WAL PUTs were resolved by read-back and slow PUTs rotated the stripe instead of failing the node, every hit was a whole-node fail-stop: this profile MEASURES that blast radius (cairnflow_failstop_total{cause}); it is not a profile expected to run chaos green. ASSUMED, not measured; rates of the same order as the other classes. Written 2026-10-18.

put.note: includes conditional PUTs (If-Match / If-None-Match) — no separate figures yet

all.note: copy, rename — cairn barely uses them

slowdown.note: client_retry simulates the 5xx retry loop of the S3 client cairn builds (object_store 0.14: 10 attempts, backoff 100 ms ×2 with jitter, capped at 15 s; 30 s in total — S3_CLIENT_RETRY_TIMEOUT) — exactly what a real node sees

faults.note: every write, every class: 5xx before reaching the store
objects cairn manages itself: written, then an error / written, then the answer of the retry
shared WAL log: written, then an error / written, then AlreadyExists from the automatic retry / lands late, after put_timeout
